turns.input: Blackthorn gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Blackthorn stands in Heartstone Square, the old tower's heavy wooden entrance looming behind you both. She wears her aubergine-purple suit immaculately tailored to her short, round frame, black bob haircut catching the daylight. She looks up at you with nearly black eyes, expression shifting between patient assessment and something not quite hiding her usual impatience.

"If we're to do business, you'll want proper footwear," she says, extending a pair of leather boots toward you. She holds them out steadily, clearly offering them outright rather than suggesting you purchase them.

She waits for your response, her scrutiny plain, two large figures looming a few steps behind her as always—present, watchful, saying nothing.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration: Blackthorn looks at the boots in Nicco's offered hand, then up at his face. Her nearly black eyes hold something flat and assessing. "Keep them," she says, her voice clipped, commercial. "Consider it an introduction. You're new to something, I can see that much—new to having, new to holding." She doesn't reach for the boots. "I've walked into plenty of rooms where the wrong shoes cost more than the right ones. These won't impress anyone who matters, but they won't mark you either, and marking's the first problem." Her hand finally moves, but only to adjust her aubergine sleeve. "Keep them or don't. I've already logged the expense."
